title: openai/tiktoken README
snippet: tiktoken is a fast BPE tokeniser for use with OpenAI's models. Example usage: enc = tiktoken.get_encoding("o200k_base"); enc = tiktoken.encoding_for_model("gpt-4o"). The open source version can be installed from PyPI with pip install tiktoken.

title: npm registry: gpt-tokenizer latest
snippet: version 3.4.0; description: A pure JavaScript implementation of a BPE tokenizer (Encoder/Decoder) for GPT-2 / GPT-3 / GPT-4 and other OpenAI models; keywords include GPT-4o and OpenAI.

title: npm registry: @dqbd/tiktoken latest
snippet: version 1.0.22; description: JS/WASM bindings for tiktoken; exports include node/default WASM and lite entrypoints.

title: Anthropic Claude Platform Docs — Token counting
snippet: All active models support token counting. Example SDK call: client.messages.count_tokens(model="claude-opus-4-8", system=..., messages=[...]) returns {"input_tokens":14}. The page notes counts may include tokens added automatically by Anthropic for system optimizations and that billing reflects only user content.

title: Google AI for Developers — Understand and count tokens
snippet: Gemini models process input and output as tokens; for Gemini, a token is about 4 characters. The page says to call count_tokens with the input request before sending and to use response usage for total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, total_thought_tokens, total_cached_tokens, total_tool_use_tokens, and total_tokens.

title: Mistral Docs — Concept Deep Dive: Tokenization
snippet: Mistral's tokenization guide says to refer to mistral-common for the tokenizer implementation; it identifies tokenizer versions V1, V2, V3, and V3-Tekken, with V3-Tekken based on tiktoken while other versions are based on sentencepiece.

title: OpenAI API Docs — Prompt caching
snippet: OpenAI usage examples include prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, and prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens. The page states cached_tokens can be monitored via the usage field results or Usage dashboard.
